titulo_es: Consigli y imperativa affermativo di tu

texto: In the first conjugation (**-are**), the imperative of * tu * ends in **-a**: **riposare → riposa!**, **parlare → parla!**, **ascoltare → ascolta!**.
In the second (**-ere**) and third conjugation (**-ire**), it ends in **-i**: **prendere → prendi!**, **dormire → dormi!**, **sentire → senti!**.

Several verbs of daily use have monosilabic or truncated forms with apothrophy: **fare → fa' / fai!**, **andare → va' / vai!**, **dare → da' / dai!**, **dire → di'!**, **stare → sta' / stai!**. For its part, **bere** does **bevi!**.

filas: Riposa un po' a letto. (Descansa un poco en la cama.)
Prendi una compressa dopo cena. (Toma una pastilla tras cenar.)
Dormi almeno otto ore stanotte. (Duerme al menos ocho horas esta noche.)
Bevi molta acqua calda con miele. (Bebe mucha agua caliente con miel.)

frases.it: Luca, ascolta bene le mie istruzioni per rimetterti in forze.
frases.es: Luca, escucha bien mis instrucciones para recuperarte.
frases.en: Luca, listen to my instructions to get you back.

frases.it: Dimmi pure, dottoressa: prendo appunti su tutto.
frases.es: Dime sin dudar, doctora: tomo notas de todo.
frases.en: Tell me without hesitation, doctor, I take notes of everything.

frases.it: Prendi questa medicina due volte al giorno e bevi molta acqua calda con limone e miele.
frases.es: Toma este medicamento dos veces al día y bebe mucha agua caliente con limón y miel.
frases.en: Take this medicine twice a day and drink a lot of hot water with lemon and honey.
analisis: drink a lot of hot water

frases.it: E per quanto riguarda il lavoro in ufficio?
frases.es: ¿Y por lo que respecta al trabajo en la oficina?
frases.en: What about work in the office?

frases.it: Non uscire oggi: riposa a casa e dormi tutto il pomeriggio!
frases.es: No salgas hoy: ¡descansa en casa y duerme toda la tarde!
frases.en: Don't go out today: rest at home and sleep all afternoon!

bloques.pregunta: How is the affirmative second person (you) imperative formed for the verbs in -are?

opciones.explicacion: Unlike the present (your riposi), the imperative of -are adopts the vowel -a.
The deinence in -i corresponds to the formal imperative of courtesy (Lei).
The infinitive is reserved for the informal negative imperative.

bloques.pregunta: What is the «tu» imperative form of the «bere» verb?

opciones.explicacion: Consolidated irregular form of the verb bere in second person.
It is the formal form of courtesy (Lei).
It is the plural form of second person (voi).

bloques.frase: Per guarire presto dalla febbre, ___ a letto tutto il giorno.

opciones.explicacion: Regular form of the second person imperative singular for -are.
It is the infinitive, not suitable for a direct affirmative order to «You».

bloques.pregunta: What advice does the statement convey?
bloques.frase: Prendi una tazza di tè caldo prima di andare a dormire.

opciones.texto: Have a cup of hot tea before you go to bed.
opciones.explicacion: «Prendi» makes a direct therapeutic recommendation to the second person.

opciones.texto: Wake up early to make breakfast.
opciones.explicacion: The recommendation is placed before sleep.

bloques.pregunta: What grammatical function does «dormi» perform in prayer?
bloques.frase: Dormi almeno otto ore per recuperare le energie.

opciones.texto: Imperativo afirmativo de segunda persona singular de «dormire».
opciones.explicacion: Give a direct advice to a trusted interlocutor.

opciones.texto: This is a first-person indicative singular.
A past minor dependent on an assistant.
opciones.explicacion: It's a simple personal form of mandate.

bloques.frase: Bevi acqua calda con limone e miele
bloques.traduccion: Drink hot water with lemon and honey

bloques.pregunta: What is the singular second person imperative for «prendere»?

opciones.explicacion: In verbs in -ere the imperative of you ends in -i: «prendi».
It corresponds to the formal formula of courtesy (Lei pastry).
It is the second person of the plural (voi).

intro: It dominates the informal second-person affirmative imperative to give advice, instructions and recommendations.
